subject: EIM kickoff: energy-inspired models as a platform library
body:
Team,

Kicking off the EIM effort for the data-platforms portfolio. Background: energy-based models are powerful but sampling and log-likelihoods are intractable because of the partition function. Our open-source EIM release sidesteps that by building the approximate sampling algorithm into the model itself, so you keep learned energy functions and still get exact samples plus tractable log-likelihood lower bounds. That property is why other teams keep copy-pasting this code - our job this quarter is to make it a supported library instead.

Milestones inside the Feb 2 - Apr 13 window: reproduce the small_problems and MNIST suites by Feb 27, API freeze for the library surface by Mar 20, adoption-ready release with docs at window close.

Santiago follows up on staffing and the eval story. OKR: two internal teams consuming the library by mid-April.

Dmitri
